stock.description: Operating as a finance leasing specialist, Baiying Holdings Group Limited delivers equipment-centric financial solutions to a diverse clientele within the People's Republic of China, encompassing small and medium-sized businesses, individual business owners, and major corporations. Its business activities are segmented into Financial Services, the trading of Packaging and Paper Products, and the production and sale of Vinegar and Wine Products. A core offering includes comprehensive finance leasing options, specifically direct leasing arrangements and sale-leaseback transactions. Beyond leasing, the company also offers commercial factoring and a range of advisory services, covering aspects such as project coordination, contract drafting and negotiation, project management, securing project financing, and ensuring regulatory compliance. Furthermore, it is involved in the manufacturing and distribution of condiment products, such as vinegar and wine, and engages in the trade of packaging and paper products. Originally established as Byleasing Holdings Limited, the company adopted its current name, Baiying Holdings Group Limited, in June 2020. Founded in 2010, its corporate headquarters are situated in Xiamen, People's Republic of China.
